answers.core: Godot Engine needs to expose the virtual memory addresses of objects or Variant objects and the rest may be implementable in an external asset. That said, I believe this should be included in core because of the lack of tools to detect/inspect/analyze the issues described in the tickets at the beginning of this issue.
answers.workaround: I do not believe this can be worked around in scripts.

title: Add virtual memory address reporting of Variant objects in the editor debugger
